**Company name**

**Website**

**US location** (city, state)
<!-- The entity at the top of the cap table must be a US corporation. Offices may be anywhere, so a Delaware parent operating from Toronto or London does qualify; a US subsidiary of a Canadian parent does not. An SEC Form D, which names the issuer and its jurisdiction, is the best evidence. -->

**Founder with a Canadian connection** (name and role)

**Nature of the connection**
<!-- Born, raised, or educated in Canada. Which institution, and which years if known.
     Adult residence, or working for a Canadian company, does not qualify on its own. -->

**Source confirming the Canadian connection** (required)
<!-- A link: university page, LinkedIn, press coverage, company bio. -->

**Founding year** and how you know it
<!-- Founder's own LinkedIn or the company's site is stronger than an aggregator. -->

**Funding raised, if any**
<!-- Round, amount, date, lead investor, and a source link for each. -->

**Anything else**
